groups.question_en: On Base 0.6B, does linear keep up with real in eval accuracy over 1,000 updates? (main runs)
groups.question_zh: Base 0.6B 上跑 1,000 个 update，linear 的 eval 准确率能跟上 real 吗？（主实验）

groups.question_en: Does the same Base 0.6B comparison hold on v5p?
groups.question_zh: 同一个 Base 0.6B 对比换到 v5p 上，结果还一样吗？

groups.question_en: Starting from the post-trained 0.6B model, does linear still keep up with real?
groups.question_zh: 换成 post-trained 0.6B，linear 还能跟上 real 吗？

groups.question_en: On the 1.5B model (R1-Distill), does linear still keep up with real?
groups.question_zh: 换成 1.5B 模型（R1-Distill），linear 还能跟上 real 吗？

groups.question_en: If linear is re-expanded at real s1's weights at update 500, does it keep up with real continued from the same point?
groups.question_zh: 把 linear 在 real s1 的 update 500 权重处重新线性化，它能跟上从同一点继续训练的 real 吗？

groups.question_en: On Base 0.6B, does linear keep up with real in eval accuracy over 1,000 updates?
groups.question_zh: Base 0.6B 上跑 1,000 个 update，linear 的 eval 准确率能跟上 real 吗？

groups.question_en: Starting from the post-trained 0.6B model, does linear still keep up with real?
groups.question_zh: 换成 post-trained 0.6B，linear 还能跟上 real 吗？

groups.question_en: On the 1.5B model (R1-Distill), does linear still keep up with real?
groups.question_zh: 换成 1.5B 模型（R1-Distill），linear 还能跟上 real 吗？

groups.question_en: Does the same 1.5B comparison look the same on H100? Seed 0 only, a reference.
groups.question_zh: 同一个 1.5B 对比换到 H100 上，real 和 linear 的曲线还一样吗？只有 seed 0，仅作参照。

groups.title_en: GB200 · Base 0.6B, lr x0.25 to x8
groups.question_en: Does scaling the lr (x0.25 to x8 of the default) change the gap between real and linear?
groups.question_zh: 把 lr 调成默认值的 x0.25 到 x8，real 和 linear 的差距会变吗？

groups.question_en: On the 1.5B model, does doubling the lr change the gap between real and linear?
groups.question_zh: 1.5B 上把 lr 加倍，real 和 linear 的差距会变吗？

groups.question_en: If linear is re-expanded at real's weights (at update 150, 300 or 500, or every K updates), does its gap to real shrink?
groups.question_zh: 把 linear 在 real 的权重处重新线性化（在 update 150、300、500，或每 K 个 update 一次），它和 real 的差距会缩小吗？

groups.question_en: With 1,024 rows per update in place of 128, does the gap between real and linear change? Runs to update 300.
groups.question_zh: 每个 update 用 1,024 rows（原来 128），real 和 linear 的差距会变吗？跑到 update 300。

groups.question_en: With a supervised objective (RFT) in place of RL, does linear keep up with real? Closed samples from the current policy, frozen from the starting model.
groups.question_zh: 把 RL 换成监督目标（RFT），linear 还能跟上 real 吗？closed 每步用当前策略采样，frozen 始终用初始模型采样。

groups.question_en: At the old run's setting (1,024-token cap, 1,024 rows per update, 300 updates), does closed-loop RFT collapse?
groups.question_zh: 在旧实验的设置下（生成上限 1,024 token、每个 update 1,024 rows、跑 300 个 update），closed RFT 会崩溃吗？
